goal: Decide how to handle the remaining Foundation setup dependency that blocks Master Data write gates, especially Gen. Business Posting Groups after customer setup route recovery.
whyNow: Master Data route comparison shows UI, template, configuration package and Excel-assisted writes are all premature while a key setup dependency remains blocked.
businessPurpose: Prevent Master Data writes from outrunning Foundation setup evidence while still allowing a realistic customer-project data route later.
expectedOutput: A compact local result JSON deciding whether the Gen. Business Posting Groups dependency is parked, source-resolved or needs a materially new read-first route.
A nextCase selection that does not repeat exhausted customer setup routes.
Explicit boundary that no setup, master data, document, Preview Posting or Posting change was made.
stopConditions: Stop if the decision requires opening Business Central or running Playwright live.
Stop if the output would create or edit Business Central data.
Stop if the output would claim setup, Master Data or process readiness.
Stop if a proposed read-first route is not materially different from the already blocked route recovery.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use if local source-based decision is enough to classify the dependency without another live route.
Use only if a materially new UI hypothesis exists for the blocked page.
Use only if the dependency is consciously parked or resolved without weakening setup boundaries.
